words.gloss: spontaneously or of its own accord

literal: Without planning, of its own accord, completion will reach, for those who strive without delay for their own family.
translation: For those who strive without delay to elevate their family, success will come spontaneously, even without deliberate planning.
modern: தன் குடும்பத்தை உயர்த்தத் தாமதிக்காமல் உழைப்பவர்களுக்கு, அவர்கள் செய்ய நினைக்கும் காரியங்கள் திட்டமிடாமலேயே தானாகவே வெற்றியை அடையும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of prompt and dedicated action in uplifting one's family. For those who work tirelessly and without procrastination ('தாழாது உஞற்றுபவர்க்கு') to improve their clan, success comes naturally. The poet suggests that such sincere efforts bear fruit spontaneously ('தானே முடிவு எய்தும்'), even without the need for elaborate or anxious planning ('சூழாமல்'). The momentum of immediate, selfless action itself clears obstacles and ensures success.
